privacy.title: Who we are
privacy.text: Sift helps people organize grocery and household receipts, and helps restaurant operators organize supplier invoices and estimate recipe costs. Personal and Business workspaces use separate records under one login. For privacy requests, contact chimpchamp92@gmail.com. This policy covers the mobile app and its supporting services.

privacy.title: Information we process
privacy.text: We process your email address and account identifiers; household or business names and workspace identifiers; receipt/invoice photos and extracted store or supplier names, addresses, account numbers, line items, product codes, package sizes, discounts, prices, quantities and dates; Business dish names, optional dish photos and recipe ingredients; subscription status and purchase identifiers; and technical crash diagnostics. Only upload documents and images you are authorized to share.

privacy.title: How we use information
privacy.text: We use this information to sign you in, separate household and business records, extract and store purchase details, compare reliably matched product prices, calculate spending and Business recipe estimates, verify subscriptions, enforce usage limits, respond to support requests and improve reliability. We do not sell your information. Sift contains no advertising SDKs.

privacy.title: AI processing and your permission
privacy.text: With your permission, receipt/invoice images and their contents, or dish names and optional dish images, are sent to Anthropic (Claude) for purchase extraction or recipe drafting. Photos may contain personal and commercial information. Sift asks before this processing. You can decline or withdraw permission in Profile; new AI requests will stop and saved records remain available. AI results can be incorrect and should be reviewed. Provider processing and retention depend on the service terms applicable to our account; contact us for details.

privacy.title: Service providers
privacy.text: Clerk provides account authentication and business organization membership. Supabase stores workspace records and private photos and runs backend functions. Anthropic processes AI requests with your permission. Apple processes App Store payments; RevenueCat verifies subscriptions using purchasing-owner/workspace and transaction identifiers. Personal Pro and Business Pro are separate subscriptions, with a shared purchasing-owner identity to preserve restoration across workspaces. Sentry receives technical diagnostics; Sift filters event content to avoid sending images and extracted purchase details. The website is hosted on Vercel. Providers process data as needed to supply these services.

privacy.title: Storage and retention
privacy.text: Saved household and business records are retained to provide history and comparisons, including after a subscription expires. Deleting a receipt/invoice queues its stored images for removal. Account deletion removes your household, authentication account and applicable personal records. Businesses where you are the only member are deleted with their invoice/recipe records and photos; shared business records remain with remaining members. Pending deletions are retried by our backend. Minimal deletion-status records are retained for up to 30 days for retry and audit purposes. Provider backups may expire on a different schedule and are not used to restore deleted records into normal service.

privacy.title: Your choices
privacy.text: Use Profile to export saved purchase history as CSV, change AI processing permission, manage an Apple subscription, or delete your account. If you are the only administrator of a shared restaurant, arrange another administrator before deleting your account. Account deletion does not cancel an Apple subscription: cancel through Apple subscription settings. For access, correction, a shared-organization deletion request, or a problem completing deletion, contact chimpchamp92@gmail.com. We may need to verify your authority over the restaurant.

privacy.title: Security and international processing
privacy.text: We use authenticated access, workspace-scoped database policies and private image storage. Personal ownership is checked against verified account and authentication-issuer identifiers; business access follows authenticated organization membership. Service providers may process data outside your country. No storage or transmission method guarantees absolute security.

privacy.title: Children and changes
privacy.text: Sift is intended for adults managing household shopping or business purchasing and is not directed at children under 16. We will update this policy when processing changes and request new AI permission when materially needed. Contact chimpchamp92@gmail.com with questions.

terms.title: The service
terms.text: Sift lets Personal users capture grocery and household receipts and Business users capture supplier invoices. Both can review extracted records and track spending. Paid plans add insights; recipe costing is a Business Pro feature. An internet connection is required for authentication, cloud records and AI processing. You retain ownership of uploaded content.

terms.title: Your account and workspaces
terms.text: Use a valid email address and protect your sign-in access. Only upload content you have permission to process. Personal records belong to your household workspace; Business records are shared with authorized organization members. Each purchasing owner can connect one Personal and one Business workspace for subscriptions. Personal Pro and Business Pro are purchased separately. A business administrator who is not the billing owner cannot restore or purchase on the owner’s behalf.

terms.title: Free and Pro plans
terms.text: Personal Free includes 5 successful receipt scans per UTC calendar month. Personal Pro includes 40 receipt scans, category/store trends and reliable repeat-item price comparisons. Business Free includes 10 successful invoice scans; Business Pro includes 100 invoice scans and 10 AI recipe draft attempts, plus Business insights and recipe tools. Limits reset on the first day of the month, independently of subscription renewal. Failed or duplicate invoice/receipt extractions do not consume the successful-scan allowance; reasonable attempt and request-rate limits apply. Recipe limits count attempts. Saved history and basic spending remain available after paid access expires. A retired Business Plus plan retains its 300-scan allowance.

terms.title: Apple subscriptions
terms.text: The App Store displays each plan’s actual localized monthly price before purchase. Personal Pro and Business Pro are separate auto-renewing subscriptions and unlock only the matching workspace type. Payment is charged to your Apple account at confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Cancelling renewal preserves access through the paid-through expiry shown in Profile. Manage or cancel through Apple subscription settings; account deletion does not cancel subscriptions. Apple handles refund requests under its applicable policies. Use Restore purchases while signed into the purchasing Sift owner account and Apple account.

terms.title: AI and accuracy
terms.text: AI extraction and recipe drafts can be inaccurate. Review dates, quantities, units, discounts and totals before saving. Personal price comparisons require a readable product identity, matching package size and attributable net price; ambiguous products or blanket discounts are excluded. Buying more or changing the basket is not a unit-price increase. Net prices can change because coupons or offers change. Business recipe costs may include labeled estimates when actual invoice costs are unavailable. Sift does not guarantee savings or provide accounting, tax or professional financial advice.

terms.title: Acceptable use
terms.text: Do not upload content you have no right to share, circumvent service limits, access another workspace’s data, interfere with the service or use it unlawfully. We may limit or suspend abusive use. Service interruptions and model-provider availability may affect new processing.

terms.title: Deletion and termination
terms.text: Initiate account deletion in Profile. Your household and sole-member businesses and their data are erased; legitimate shared business records remain with other members. The only administrator of a shared business must arrange another administrator before leaving. See the Privacy Policy and contact chimpchamp92@gmail.com if you need help.

terms.title: Disclaimers and liability
terms.text: To the extent permitted by applicable law, the service is provided as available without a guarantee of uninterrupted operation or error-free results. We are not responsible for decisions made from unverified AI output. Where lawful, our aggregate liability relating to the service is limited to the amount you paid us in the preceding 12 months. Nothing in these terms limits rights or liability that cannot lawfully be limited.

terms.title: Changes and contact
terms.text: We will update these terms when necessary and provide notice of material changes where required. Questions about service or billing: chimpchamp92@gmail.com. Apple’s applicable licensed application terms also apply to the iOS app.
